METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

4. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

5. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.

6. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.

7. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.

8. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Forging.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

11. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Gas Welding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
